title: Bonsai Automata
game_overview: An idle zen simulation featuring automated power and irrigation grids to grow bonsais to level 100, combined with reaction-based wilderness excursions.
winning_condition: Successfully discover and cultivate the rarest botanical specimen in the wilderness—the Mythic Golden Ginkgo Bonsai—to Level 100 Mastery in your automated sanctuary.
losing_condition: None. The game is a relaxing zen experience with no fail state or game over. When the expedition backpack reaches maximum capacity, the player simply cannot carry additional items and returns to the starting campsite portal to transport all gathered resources back to the sanctuary.

controls.action: Dig action in the radial shovel minigame during excursions.

controls.input: W/A/S/D or Arrow Keys / Virtual Joystick
controls.action: Move the botanist explorer across the excursion overworld.
Select bonsais to prune, purchase machinery upgrades, and manage inventory slots.
Open inventory and equipment backpack screen.
Switch between Greenhouse Sanctuary and Wilderness Excursion view.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. Proximity-Bound Irrigation Halos: Sprinkler water coverage halos (T1, T2, T3) and manual irrigation auras are strictly bound to player proximity, remaining invisible unless the player avatar is standing directly on top of the installation's grid plot. 2. Unified Crystal Architecture & Non-Botanical Telemetry: Crystals discovered during rover expeditions (Foliage Emerald, Branch Amber, Trunk Coral, Root Azure) render using the exact faceted gemstone vector aesthetics found on pedestal mounts. Crystal scanning and excavation interfaces strictly communicate elemental aspect and power tier (+0.5 or +1.0 strength) without revealing or displaying tree-specific maturity ratings or botanical classifications. 3. Refined T2 Manual Irrigation Engineering: Replaced distorted water sprites on the T2 Manual Irrigation System with an authentic timber A-frame supporting an iron-banded cedar barrel, four directional copper outlet pipes with brass fittings, and microscopic circular water droplets at the nozzle tips.
sections.summary: Proximity-Bound Irrigation Halos, Unified Crystal Architecture, and Refined Hydro-Engineering Graphics.
